contatti.tipsDesc: To guarantee a stress-free arrival and start your Roman stay at its best, please follow these simple instructions:
contatti.t1Desc: Standard check-in is available from 2:00 PM onwards. Please let us know your expected arrival time or any delays at least 30-60 minutes in advance via call or WhatsApp.

contatti.t3Desc: Upon arrival we will give you the breakfast voucher included in your stay, usable at the renowned Pasticceria Pompi (located a few steps away in Via Albalonga).

suitesDetail.title: Roman suites with a taste of la dolce vita
suitesDetail.p1: Each suite offers a king-size bedroom, a cozy living room, a fully equipped kitchenette, and a private bathroom with a rain shower.
suitesDetail.p2: Perfect for leisure and business stays, the property guarantees modern comfort and premium services: high-speed Wi-Fi, self check-in, soundproof windows, espresso machine, air conditioning, and Smart TV. Complimentary breakfast voucher at Pompi, Rome's iconic pastry shop famous for its tiramisu.
suitesDetail.p3: Just 150 meters from Re di Roma metro (Line A), Bell Suites puts you steps away from the Colosseum, the Basilica of San Giovanni, and the city's main attractions. (Semi-basement floor, not serviced by an elevator, accessible via a short flight of stairs.)
